units.source_text: 这时，安永四段走进对局室，跪坐在门槛前，双手着地，诚心诚意地施了个礼。

en.t: At that moment, Yasunaga, fourth dan, entered the playing room, knelt before the threshold, placed both hands on the floor, and bowed with complete sincerity.
It was an act of devout worship.
The two players did not notice.

units.source_text: 名人和七段每次朝向这边，安永总恭恭敬敬地垂下头来。

en.t: Whenever the Master and the seventh dan turned in his direction, Yasunaga would always lower his head with reverent courtesy.

units.source_text: 简直是除了如此顶礼膜拜之外，别无他事了。

en.t: It was almost as if he had nothing else to do but offer such profound obeisance.

units.source_text: 这莫非是鬼神凄怆的对局？

en.t: Could this have been a game so sorrowful that even spirits and gods would grieve?
